subs: Beds on its Medicare cost report. A licensed bed count usually runs higher.
Every intensive and special care unit counts: adult, cardiac, surgical, burn, neonatal and pediatric.
Each inpatient stay that ended counts once, whoever paid for it.
All inpatient days divided by discharges. Answer in days, like 4.5.
Patient days divided by the bed days it had available.
Medicare Advantage plans included. Counted in days spent in a bed, not in people.
Medicaid managed care plans included. Counted in days spent in a bed, not in people.
Two half-time employees count as one. Hospital payroll only: not clinics, not contract staff.
Interns and residents: doctors training after medical school. Two half-time count as one.
From AHRQ's 2023 list of who owns which hospital, matched to Medicare's hospital list.
Out of every hospital in Maryland on Medicare's list, every kind counted.
Every one of its hospitals' latest Medicare cost report, added up.
Biggest by beds on its cost report. The answer names the hospital.
Two half-time employees count as one. Hospital payrolls only: clinics, offices and any health plan are left out.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Anne Arundel Medical Center have on its payroll in fiscal 2025?
questions.why: No other Luminis Health hospital reports more; Doctors Community Medical Center is next at 1,111. About 6.1 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Doctors Community Medical Center have on its payroll in fiscal 2025?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 Luminis Health hospitals; Anne Arundel Medical Center has the most, 2,528. About 4.9 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did J Kent McNew Family Medical Center have on its payroll in fiscal 2025?
questions.why: That is the fewest of 3 Luminis Health hospitals; Anne Arundel Medical Center has the most, 2,528. About 2.0 for every bed.

questions.q: How many hospitals does Luminis Health run, by the federal list of health systems?
questions.why: All of them are in Maryland. A system's own count can differ: it may count campuses on their own, or hospitals that joined after 2023.

questions.q: What percent of the hospitals in Maryland belong to Luminis Health?
questions.why: 3 of 56. The next biggest system there, University of Maryland Medical System, has 11.
